_comment: Fixed parameter bindings baked as literals into every query file (all three engines use IDENTICAL bindings for fairness). For a real SF dataset, pick valid ids/dates from the data and re-substitute the literals in input_*/ files. Temporal columns in the normalized CSVs are epoch-second integers; birthday is YYYYMMDD.

_normalized_schema.message.csv: m_messageid,m_creationdate,m_creatorid,m_locationid,m_c_replyof  (message = post UNION ALL comment; m_c_replyof null for posts)
